candidates: In RST documentation, use the `:keyword:` role (or `:py:keyword:`) when referencing Python language keywords such as `assert`, `return`, or `yield` — never `:func:`, which implies a callable defined in a library or user code.

Do not add manual `.. function::` (or similar) directive blocks in project docs to re-document Python built-in keywords; the `:keyword:` role already links to the authoritative Python documentation, making inline re-documentation redundant and liable to drift.
